div.head: I Cn 4.1
div.ab: Forþam, understande se ðe cunne, mycel is ⁊ mære þæt sacerd ah to donne folc to þearfe, gif he his Drihtne gecwemeð mid rihte.
Forðam, understande se ðe wylle oðð cunne, mycel is ⁊ mære þæt sacerd ah to dónne folce to ðearfe, gyf he hys Dryhtne gecwemað mid rihte.
Et, intelligat qui potest (qui scit, intelligat), magnum semper est et mire pręcipuum quod ad uelle Domini faciendum est sacerdoti pro salute populi.
Forþam, understande se ðe cunne, mycel is ⁊ mære þæt sacerd ah to donne folce to þearfe, gif he his Drihtne gecwemeð mid rihte.
Forþam understande se ðe cunne: mycel is and mære þæt sacerd ah to donne folce to þearfe, gif he his Drihtne gecwemeð mid rihte.
Denn — begreife wer (will oder A) kann — gross ist und hehr, was ein Priester, wenn er seinem Herrn recht wohlgefällig ist, dem Volke zum Nutzen zu verrichten vermag:
For — let him understand who (will or, A) can — great and glorious is what a priest can do for the benefit of the people, if he pleases his Lord rightly:
Because—let him understand who can—great and wonderful are the things which a priest is able to do for the benefit of the people, if he is duly pleasing to his Lord.
For let this be understood by those who can: great and wondrous are those things which a priest can do for the benefit of the people if he pleases his Lord rightly.
